THE PROCEDURE / 01

FOUR PHONES.
ONE BAD IDEA.

The big screen runs the fight. Your phones run the detectives.

Get your crew together. Once everybody is ready, the case opens.

THE ARSENAL / 02

THREE GUNS.
ONE TRIGGER FINGER.

Everybody walks in with a pistol. The rest is out there in The Pit, floating, waiting for whoever gets there first.

The Gunner fires, aims and reloads from their phone; the Runner gets you to the pickup. Grab a gun and it's yours until the magazine runs dry, or until you're taken out.

THE SIDEARM

PISTOL

Every raccoon starts with one. Quick, steady, and always there.

DAMAGE22
FIRE RATE3.6 / s
RANGE100 m
MAGAZINE12

Five body shots or three to the head. 1.25 s reload.

THE ALLEY SWEEPER

SHOTGUN

Nine pellets per shell. Up close, one shell nearly ends it.

DAMAGE9 × 11
FIRE RATE1.2 / s
RANGE28 m
MAGAZINE6

Floating pickup, gone when it runs dry. 1.8 s reload.

THE LONG GOODBYE

SNIPER

Scope in from across the block. One clean headshot is all it takes.

DAMAGE90
FIRE RATE0.7 / s
RANGE200 m
MAGAZINE5

Tap AIM to scope. Headshots do double. 2.2 s reload.

THE RULES / 03

THE PIT.
NO WAY OUT.

A three-level city block, soaked in rain. Plenty of places to hide. None to stay.

FIRST TO 10 KILLS
OR LEAD WHEN 05:00 RUNS OUT
01

SHARE THE DAMAGE

One health bar. Heal after a few quiet seconds. Brief spawn protection.

02

FIND YOUR FIREPOWER

Pistol to start. Floating shotgun and sniper pickups.

03

WATCH YOUR HAT

A headshot sends the fedora flying. Just business.
